title: Client Discovery Harness - Source Metadata
description: Where a piece of evidence came from, for an uploaded file or a retrieved page alike. There is deliberately no filename field and no text field: the original name can itself be sensitive, and document text is never persisted in ephemeral mode. The file fields and the retrieval fields are mutually exclusive - whichever set does not apply stays null rather than being filled with a plausible-looking value, because a fabricated file_type on a web page corrupts the provenance trail it exists to protect. core.evidence.check_source_metadata enforces that.

source_id.description: Random opaque id. Must not be derived from the uploaded filename.

source_origin.description: How the material reached the harness. Distinct from source_category, which says what it is.

display_label.description: A name the uploading person typed so they can recognise this source later. Never derived from the filename, never auto-filled, control characters stripped. It is not in the logging allowlist, and in PERSISTENT mode it is stored with the rest of this record - see docs/privacy.md.

publisher.description: SEARCH_RESULT only. Its absence limits confidence - see core/research/confidence.py.

retrieved_at.description: SEARCH_RESULT only. When this harness read it, as opposed to when it was published.

processing_status.description: PURGED means extraction finished and the original was deleted - the normal terminal state in ephemeral mode.

error_code.description: Short non-sensitive code. Never an exception message, which can carry document content.
